title: Combatting adversarial distillation
headline: OpenAI reports on strategies to mitigate adversarial model distillation risks
summary: OpenAI has detailed its multi-layered approach to preventing adversarial distillation, a process where actors extract a model's capabilities and internal reasoning to train unprotected versions. The company uses a combination of adversarial training, input and output classifiers, and API-level protections to secure chain-of-thought reasoning. These measures are supported by ongoing investigations into coordinated campaigns and the sharing of threat intelligence with industry partners.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying frontier AI models must implement robust safeguards around internal reasoning traces to prevent the unauthorized transfer of sensitive capabilities to less secure systems.

quotes.text: Adversarial distillation creates a path for bad actors to reproduce these capabilities without appropriate safeguards.
Our cyber distillation results suggest that protecting reasoning traces can limit cyber capability transfer, even when the underlying task is one allowed under our usage policies

classification.significance_reason: This report provides a technical blueprint for securing frontier models against capability extraction, which is a critical concern for global AI safety and national security.
